name: Hasis
source:
Hasis is a mysterious young man whom Alice meets in the church.

He is a highly skilled assassin. Raised from childhood as a member of an assassin organization, his life has revolved around executing targets in a dark and narrow world.

To Hasis, Alice’s smile was a ray of hope. How will encountering her change the life of this young man who has only known darkness?

On dates with Hasis, you'll discover that he's not merely emotionless, but that there’s another side hidden deep within him.

Gently help him reveal the true feelings he keeps hidden inside.
